profile_scope: Operator timings use device-event graph replay, 128 calls per sample, 3 shuffled rounds. Profile fractions use sums of GPU kernel durations, not serving wall time. Kernel is the only fleet-exclusive consumer symbol and appears exactly 18 times per decode forward; its cost includes unpack, not pure LoRA B. Other generic kernels remain unknown. 12-step windows include prefill and decode, reported separately. Null routes and adapter counts are varied in micro tests. These are not end-to-end speedups.

narrow_full_model.limits: One same-card run; fixed ab/control/native/base order; three repeats; synthetic adapters; numerical samples eight tokens, speed samples 64. Base is unfused, no-AITER. Strict native logprob gate remains reported, not a speed blocker.

wide_micro.scope: Warmed graph device timing; 128 calls per sample, 3 randomized rounds; both GDN paths reuse fixed persistent outputs. This does not predict service speedup. Rank4 full-model choices require >=3 percent gain at every tested adapter count for that batch size; all rank8 cases remain diagnostics.

combined_full_model.limits: One same-card run; fixed control-before/all/native/base/control-after order; three repeats; synthetic adapters; numerical samples eight tokens, speed samples 64. Base is unfused, no-AITER. Strict native logprob gate remains reported, not a speed blocker. Before/after controls quantify within-allocation drift, not across-run confidence intervals.

micro.selection: At least1percent device-event gain at every sampled adapter count, rank4 capacity; partial ranks1/2/3/4 and route/rank changes require bitwise equality.

rank4_specialization.scope: Only narrow capacity4 changed; controls use all selected GDN/wide fusions. Fixed before/specialized/native/after order, same card, three repeats, eight-token numerical cases and64-token timing. No fresh base-only arm. Native logprob gate is retained separately. Bracket drift is not an across-run confidence interval.

narrow.scope: CPU wiring/contracts only; numerical and speed evidence requires allocated GPU.

gdn.scope: CPU GDN callback composition check; not a numerical/GPU claim.

wide.scope: CPU wide hook dispatch and fallback check, independent of GPU numerics.

specialization.scope: CPU selector verifies rank8/tile128/unmeasured batches fall back; no numerical claim

cpu_tests.scope: Existing complete CPU regression suite; no GPU numerical claim

local_checks.build: Wheel/sdist builds pass; final archive inspection covers all three new benchmark .cu sources and Python callers
local_checks.benchmark_import: Both lazy loader imports leave Torch absent; rank4 CLI --help works in CPU Torch environment

boundaries: The new kernels are benchmark-only research prototypes; library defaults and tiny-profile flag do not install these serving hooks.
Operator graph timings use 128 calls/sample and 3 randomized rounds; neither model cache residency nor model throughput follows from these ratios.
The wide operator screen reuses fixed persistent outputs for both GDN arms; 84 cases have zero eager max_abs and 28 GDN cases pass changed-route replay.
Rank4 dispatch is selected per batch only if all sampled adapter counts improve by at least 3 percent; batch32 gate/up retains RowExpand.
Full model: 128 input/64 forced output tokens, 3 repeats, 32/192/384 requests at C1/8/32; numerical cases use 8 output tokens.
One allocation per full-model study; final run brackets the candidate with before/after controls. This is not an across-run confidence interval.
Base is the existing no-AITER unfused configuration; packed base caches add approximately289MiB. No larger model, trained quality, vision, MoE, quantization or TP validation.
Native strict logprob failures remain recorded separately from the explicitly authorized nonblocking timing gate.

The wide study experienced login-node storage metadata timeouts during startup, then completed without GPU resubmission. Timed graph loops access resident device buffers; file writes occur outside them.

Rank4 specialization changes only narrow A+B: constant K/capacity, unrolled chunks, vector B loads. It passes30 exact operator/changed-metadata graph cases including two with ranks1/2/3/4. Its whole-model control is the selected all-fusion profile, with no fresh base-only arm.
